THE ONE-PAGE YEAR
Northing Studio · v1.0 · 2026-09

One page you'll actually look at.


WHAT'S INSIDE
-------------
NorthingStudio_One-Page-Year_A4.pdf        2 pages · A4, 210 x 297 mm, portrait
NorthingStudio_One-Page-Year_Letter.pdf    2 pages · US Letter, 8.5 x 11 in, portrait
NorthingStudio_One-Page-Year_Tablet.pdf    2 pages · 1620 x 2160 px, portrait
licences/                                the font licences for this file

Page 1 is the plan: one sentence, three goals, why those three, the first step
for each, and the one habit you keep on a bad week.
Page 2 is how to use it, and what comes next.

Undated. Use it in any year, starting any day.

The Letter edition is laid out separately for the shorter, wider sheet. It is
not a scaled copy of the A4, so nothing shifts in the margins when you print it.


PRINTING
--------
Print at 100% — in the print dialog choose "Actual size", not "Fit to page" or
"Shrink oversized pages". Portrait. Single-sided, so you can pin page 1 up.

Use the A4 file or the Letter file to match your paper. Both are ink-light: they
print in pure black and white with no loss, and they use very little ink.

The writing lines are 7.5 mm apart, which suits a normal pen.


ON A TABLET
-----------
Works with GoodNotes, Notability and Samsung Notes. Import the Tablet PDF and
write on it with a stylus as you would on paper.

The Tablet file is a flat page — there are no tabs to tap, because a two-page
file does not need them.


LICENCE
-------
This file is for your own personal use. Print as many copies as you like for
yourself. Please don't resell it, redistribute it, or include it in another
product.

The fonts (Fraunces, Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Mono) are licensed under the SIL
Open Font License 1.1, which permits commercial use and embedding. The full
licence texts are in the licences/ folder. The font files are not sold or
redistributed on their own.


IF SOMETHING IS WRONG
---------------------
Email hello@northingstudio.example and tell us what happened — which file, which
page, and what your printer or app did. We answer every message.


IF IT HELPED
------------
A rating takes a few seconds and is the single most useful thing you can do for
a small shop. If this page earned one, we'd be grateful.

This page is free and complete as it is. There is no locked version of it.


A structured self-reflection tool. Not therapy, diagnosis or financial advice.
